platform_names: Your profile [settings]; Manage stores [settings]; Staff accounts [help centre]; Staff members [admin-navigation]; Roles & permissions [admin-navigation]; Logs & activity [help centre]; Activity history [admin-navigation]; Store management [admin-navigation]; Staff [admin-navigation]; موظفو المتجر [plan-features]; Logs [admin-navigation]
plain_line: Who gets into a store and what they did there: the merchant's login, profile and devices, the several stores one account can manage, staff accounts with roles and permissions, the activity and export logs, and the access a partner or Salla's support can be given to a store.
note: The settings menu, the dashboard menu and the help centre each list these apart (profile and stores under settings, staff and logs under the dashboard, partner access in the Partners portal); grouped because each says who may act in a store.

plain_line: The store's own settings: its name, status and maintenance mode, its domain, SSL and DNS records, the notifications and SMS sender name it uses, and the Salla AI Connector and AI tools for writing product text and SEO.
note: The help centre's Store settings & tools holds general settings, domains and languages; the notifications and AI Connector pages are other pages of the same settings menu, added here. Its languages are in SA-A-30 (the review of the areas list, finding 4).

platform_names: Store plan [settings]; Plans & subscriptions [help centre]; باقة المتجر [help centre]; Support center [help centre]; مدير حساب مخصص [plan-features]
plain_line: The plan a store subscribes to (Basic, Plus, Pro or Special), its trial, renewal and freezing, and the support Salla gives merchants on each plan, up to a dedicated account manager.
note: Salla's support desk has its own help-centre heading; placed with the plans because the plan tables list the support team and the dedicated account manager as plan features.

platform_names: Store Verification [admin-navigation]; توثيق المتجر [help centre]; New store [help centre]; Creating a Store Outside Saudi Arabia [help centre]; Requirements & compliance [help centre]; E-commerce regulations [help centre]; Banking & IBAN setup [help centre]
plain_line: Opening a store and verifying the merchant's business in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait and the other countries Salla serves, the bank account that receives the store's dues, and the licences and restricted activities a merchant must observe.
note: The help centre splits this between New store and Store verification tips; the licences and restricted-activity concerns are added because the extract shows them only as scopes of verification, App Maker and country articles.

plain_line: What a store sells and holds: products of every type with their options, variants, categories, brands and digital content; stock quantities across branches and warehouses; importing and exporting products, orders and customers; product restrictions, pre-order campaigns and back-in-stock alerts.

plain_line: Receiving and handling orders: their statuses, options and custom fields, assignment to staff, invoices, returns, refunds and cancellation, the hours and limits for accepting orders, and bookings.

plain_line: The store's customers: their records, tags and groups, how they log in and register, the addresses they give, and the export or deletion of their personal data.

platform_names: Help Desk [admin-navigation]; Reviews & questions [admin-navigation]; Salla Chat [admin-navigation]; Self-service system [admin-navigation]; Complaints [admin-navigation]
plain_line: Hearing from the store's customers: product and store reviews and questions, chat through Salla Chat, and the ticket and complaints system.
note: The dashboard's Help Desk heading; its Quality gateway entry is placed with shipping (SA-A-19), where the help centre puts it.

platform_names: Marketing [help centre]; Marketing [admin-navigation]; أدوات التسويق [plan-features]; Coupons [admin-navigation]; Promotional Offers [admin-navigation]; Abandoned carts [admin-navigation]; Campaigns [admin-navigation]; Marketing calendar [admin-navigation]; Loyalty program [admin-navigation]; Gifting [admin-navigation]; Quick checkout [admin-navigation]; Reorder Reminder [admin-navigation]; عروض البنك [term]; Advertisements [term]; Blog [settings]; SEO [admin-navigation]
plain_line: The store's own tools for selling more: coupons, special and bank offers, abandoned-cart recovery, SMS, push and email campaigns, the loyalty program, gifting, quick checkout, reorder reminders, the announcement bar, the blog and SEO.
note: The customer wallet, which Salla files here, is in SA-A-34 (the review of the areas list, finding 5).

platform_names: Affiliate marketing [admin-navigation]; Influencers [admin-navigation]; التسويق بالعمولة [help centre]; التسويق مع المؤثرين [help centre]
plain_line: Selling through other people: the store's affiliate program with its commissions, links and coupons, and campaigns with influencers booked through Salla.
note: Two entries of the dashboard's and the help centre's marketing menus, taken out of SA-A-09 together because both pay outside marketers for sales.

platform_names: Salla Ads [admin-navigation]; إعلانات سلة [help centre]; Pixels & feeds [admin-navigation]
plain_line: Paid advertising run from the dashboard through Salla Ads on Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, Google and others, and the tracking pixels, conversion links and product feeds that connect the store to advertising platforms.
note: Two entries of the dashboard's marketing menu, taken out of SA-A-09 together because both connect the store to outside advertising platforms.

platform_names: Store design & themes [help centre]; Online Store [admin-navigation]; تصميم المتجر [plan-features]; Theme Marketplace [admin-navigation]; Landing pages [admin-navigation]; Information pages [admin-navigation]; Custom URLs [admin-navigation]
plain_line: How the storefront looks: choosing and customising a theme from the Theme Marketplace, theme versions, landing pages, information pages, menus and custom URLs.
note: The dashboard's Online Store heading, with its Domain entry placed in SA-A-02, and the help centre's Store design & themes, which adds landing pages.

platform_names: Storefront [extension-points]; Themes [admin-navigation]; Twilight Engine [extension-points]; Twilight SDK [extension-points]; Web Components [extension-points]; Ecommerce Events [extension-points]; My Themes [admin-navigation]; Theme Purchases [admin-navigation]
plain_line: Building themes on Salla's Twilight engine: the storefront SDK, web components and e-commerce events a theme uses, the API storefront pages call, and publishing and selling themes through the Partners portal.
note: Joins two of the platform's headings: the developer documentation's Storefront and the Partners portal's Themes; grouped because all of them are what a theme developer builds with or sells through.

platform_names: Mobile app [help centre]; Mobile app [admin-navigation]; App Maker [extension-points]
plain_line: A store's own iOS and Android app made with App Maker: the subscription, the app's design, and publishing it under the merchant's Apple and Google developer accounts.

platform_names: Salla Point [help centre]; Salla PointFree Cashier [admin-navigation]; كاشير سلة بوينت [help centre]; Salla Point [other:partner-access-permissions]
plain_line: Selling in person with Salla Point, the cashier app: its dashboard, employees, branches, card payments, discounts, returns and products.

platform_names: Sales channels [help centre]; Sales channels [settings]; قنوات البيع [plan-features]; Sales Channels [admin-navigation]; Mahally [help centre]; سوق الجملة [term]
plain_line: Selling beyond the store's own site: the channels a product is published to, global shopping platforms, the Mahally platform (منصة محلي), and the wholesale market (سوق الجملة) with its vendors.

plain_line: How customers pay: the checkout page and cart, buy-now-pay-later, PayPal and other wallets, outside payment gateways, bank transfer, cash on delivery, payment links, recurring payments, payment restrictions and fraud protection.
note: The plan table's الدفع heading; its fee calculator and currencies lines are placed in SA-A-18 and SA-A-29, and the checkout settings page is added. Salla Payments' own methods are in SA-A-31, and charity stores' payment gateways in SA-A-33 (the review of the areas list, findings 2 and 7).

platform_names: محفظة المتجر والفوترة [plan-features]; Wallet [admin-navigation]; Balance & billing [settings]; Store wallet [help centre]; Transactions [admin-navigation]; رصيد المدفوعات الإلكترونية [term]; حاسبة رسوم المدفوعات الإلكترونية [term]; Settlements [term]
plain_line: Money between Salla and the merchant: the store balance that pays Salla's bills, the e-payments balance and its transfer cycle to the merchant's bank, payment fees and the currency of settlement, refunds and reversals of transactions, settlements withheld by dropshipping apps, and who processes the payments.
note: The plan table's محفظة المتجر والفوترة heading and the dashboard's Wallet page, which hold the store balance, billing and the e-payments balance; fees, transactions, settlements, the payment processor and the settlement currency are added. Financing is in SA-A-32 (the review of the areas list, finding 3).

platform_names: Shipping & delivery [help centre]; Shipping [admin-navigation]; الشحن والتوصيل [plan-features]; Shipping & delivery [admin-navigation]; Shipping settings [admin-navigation]; Shipping Routes [admin-navigation]; International Shipping Readiness [admin-navigation]; Packaging [admin-navigation]; Quality gateway [admin-navigation]; بوليصات سلة [term]
plain_line: Getting orders to customers: Salla's discounted shipping labels and the carriers behind them, the merchant's own carriers, shipping zones, rates and restrictions, routes, shipments and their tracking, branch pickup, packaging, international shipping, delivery promises, shipping apps, and the quality gateway for shipping complaints.

platform_names: Taxes [settings]; Tax settings [admin-navigation]; الربط مع هيئة الزكاة والضريبة [term]
plain_line: The taxes a store charges: VAT settings and tax-inclusive prices, the e-invoicing link with the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority, and customs duties on cross-border orders.

platform_names: Markets [settings]; Multi-market [help centre]; Market selection [settings]
plain_line: Selling to several countries from one store: per-country versions of the store with their own settings.
note: Its currencies are in SA-A-29 (the review of the areas list, finding 4).

plain_line: The countries Salla names as those it serves, such as Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman, and the country lists its API and the Partners portal give, with the API's cities and districts.
note: No menu names the countries; the site footer's list, the App Store's country list, the Partners portal's country list and the API's country list are joined here because each says where the platform works.

note: The developer documentation lists these under several headings (Merchant, Partner APIs, Dev Tools); grouped because all are what an app developer builds with.
